g.text: every frame encoded INDEPENDENTLY · t folded into the batch
module: the encoder, the predictor and the target – none of the three carries time
the encoder – t is folded into the BATCH
“the encoder otherwise has no temporal structure whatsoever” · visual_world_model.py:1280
no attention across t, no state, no positional link – block_causal is the flag that would change it, and it is off in 872 of 875 archived configs
the predictor – a 3-tap FIR bank, and a HARD cutoff at H
zt+1 = Σk=0 Ak zt−k + B at , k < H = num_frames = num_hist = 3
no A3 · nothing older than zt−2 is in the graph
no A4 · and no state carries it forward
models/infojepa_modules.py:729 `if dk >= T: break` · T = num_hist, so a lag at or beyond H is dropped, exactly
the target – it is NOT detached, so the encoder trains through its own prediction target
what every run in this archive did
“the cheapest way to lower S is therefore not to predict better but to inflate z and z_pred together” · :606
the 32 exceptions are round 8's OWN ladder, launched this round
frameskip = 5 in 875 of 875 – every arm, every round
